title: Last few months have been disappointing
text: I’ve been getting this box for quite many months. I have the dietary restricted option one that should include an extra toy because my cat is on prescription food and can’t eat random treats. My last two boxes listed treats and did not include a substitution. My Halloween themed box arrived AFTER Halloween and I’m super disappointed that this months theme is farm something or other and not holiday/winter themed. Honestly my cat enjoys the tissue paper and box more than the toys. I just skipped next month but think I’ll be cancelling.
label: neutral
